classical
intro symbol
apply Classical.choice
fin_cases symbol <;>
  first
  | exact ⟨ComplexityReduction.Agent.GenerativeReduction.Plugins.BooleanCSPFiniteGadget.gadgetOfPlannedSearch _
      [()] _
      6 (by decide) (by decide)
      ComplexityReduction.Agent.GenerativeReduction.Plugins.BooleanCSPFiniteGadget.templates
      (by simp [ComplexityReduction.Agent.Hardness.BooleanCSPAuthoringSources.PositiveNAE3CSP.gamma, Benchmark.Hardness.Inputs.BooleanCSPNPHard.Case02PositiveNAE4.gamma] <;> decide)⟩
  | exact ⟨ComplexityReduction.Agent.GenerativeReduction.Plugins.BooleanCSPFiniteGadget.gadgetOfPlannedSearch _
      [false, true] _
      6 (by decide) (by decide)
      ComplexityReduction.Agent.GenerativeReduction.Plugins.BooleanCSPFiniteGadget.templates
      (by simp [ComplexityReduction.Agent.Hardness.BooleanCSPAuthoringSources.PositiveNAE3CSP.gamma, Benchmark.Hardness.Inputs.BooleanCSPNPHard.Case02PositiveNAE4.gamma] <;> decide)⟩
  | exact ⟨ComplexityReduction.Agent.GenerativeReduction.Plugins.BooleanCSPFiniteGadget.gadgetOfPlannedSearch _
      (Finset.univ.toList) _
      6 (by decide) (by decide)
      ComplexityReduction.Agent.GenerativeReduction.Plugins.BooleanCSPFiniteGadget.templates
      (by simp [ComplexityReduction.Agent.Hardness.BooleanCSPAuthoringSources.PositiveNAE3CSP.gamma, Benchmark.Hardness.Inputs.BooleanCSPNPHard.Case02PositiveNAE4.gamma] <;> decide)⟩

      [()] _
      6 (by decide) (by decide)
      ComplexityReduction.Agent.GenerativeReduction.Plugins.BooleanCSPFiniteGadget.templates

  | exact ⟨ComplexityReduction.Agent.GenerativeReduction.Plugins.BooleanCSPFiniteGadget.gadgetOfPlannedSearch _
      [false, true] _
      6 (by decide) (by decide)
      ComplexityReduction.Agent.GenerativeReduction.Plugins.BooleanCSPFiniteGadget.templates
      (by simp [ComplexityReduction.Agent.Hardness.BooleanCSPAuthoringSources.PositiveNAE3CSP.gamma, Benchmark.Hardness.Inputs.BooleanCSPNPHard.Case09PositiveExactlyTwo4.gamma] <;> decide)⟩
  | exact ⟨ComplexityReduction.Agent.GenerativeReduction.Plugins.BooleanCSPFiniteGadget.gadgetOfPlannedSearch _
      (Finset.univ.toList) _
      6 (by decide) (by decide)
      ComplexityReduction.Agent.GenerativeReduction.Plugins.BooleanCSPFiniteGadget.templates
